checkpoint_semantics: SQLite commit before send-code returns or PasswordRequired propagates; success and expired code cleanup; no code/password storage
process_boundary_tests: Fresh subprocess calls os._exit(0) without disconnect; fresh client restores auth key and code/password stage
compatibility: Optional additive version-1 snapshot field; old files accepted; persistent storage requires POSIX locks
live_telegram_restart_test: Not run: no account credentials. Controlled backend responses only.
security: Phone, server code hash and auth key are sensitive plaintext session metadata; permissions 0600, transactional writes; code/password never stored. No independent security audit.
limitations: Temporary sessions do not survive process death
Telegram can expire codes or revoke keys
An interrupted operation before checkpoint commit may have an ambiguous result
Parallel login flows on one Client unsupported
